scenes: A heat warning goes out. | Then what?
Good alerts come in levels, | and each level switches on named actions, like these.
Delhi’s 2025 plan tied its graded alerts to cooling shelters, | three thousand water points, and heatstroke units in hospitals.
A warning is only as good as what it switches on.
